g.text: VXLAN: wrap the container's whole Ethernet frame inside a UDP packet
MAC-in-UDP. The underlay only ever sees ordinary UDP between two hosts.
After (what leaves the host, via the VTEP):
counts against the MTU: outer IP 20 + UDP 8 + VXLAN 8 + inner Eth 14 = 50 bytes
VNI = a 24-bit network ID (about 16 million networks, versus 4096 for VLANs). VTEP = the VXLAN Tunnel Endpoint that wraps and unwraps; in Swarm each host's kernel
UDP source port varies per flow (entropy for load balancing); destination port is 4789.
